items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: Gene had to deal with being in the quartet and being wildly successful and a little bit parallel to like Jackie Robinson.

ctx.x: I’ll have to go to work.

And Joe and Gene — and then right, like my parents always had great admiration for Gene in terms of his personality. Like he was just a guy — Gene was very special not only from his musical point of view but people have to realize that Gene had to deal with being in the quartet and being wildly successful and a little bit parallel to like Jackie Robinson. Other black musicians were giving him crap about, “You’re playing with these white guys? Why are you playing with these white guys.” You know, “the white guys are
stealing our music” and all that kind of crap. And Gene just handled it with typical diplomacy and grace. I don’t know maybe that’s how he got the name “Senator.”
